tools.name: list_projects
tools.title: List DebugBundle projects
tools.description: List the DebugBundle projects available through the current OAuth grant.

tools.name: list_services
tools.title: List project services
tools.description: List known services and environments for one authorized DebugBundle project.

tools.name: list_incidents
tools.title: List project incidents
tools.description: List bounded recent or active incidents for one authorized DebugBundle project.

tools.name: get_incident
tools.title: Get an incident
tools.description: Read the summary and lifecycle state of one authorized DebugBundle incident.

tools.name: get_incident_context
tools.title: Get incident context
tools.description: Read bounded deterministic incident and existing artifact-derived context without raw logs or regeneration.

tools.name: get_bundle
tools.title: Get a debug bundle
tools.description: Read an existing bounded redacted debug bundle without regenerating or queueing work.

tools.name: get_reproduction
tools.title: Get reproduction evidence
tools.description: Read existing bounded redacted reproduction evidence without regenerating or queueing work.

tools.name: list_improvements
tools.title: List improvement opportunities
tools.description: List bounded runtime improvement opportunities for one authorized DebugBundle project.

tools.name: get_improvement
tools.title: Get an improvement opportunity
tools.description: Read one authorized runtime improvement opportunity and its bounded evidence summary.

tools.name: get_improvement_bundle
tools.title: Get an improvement bundle
tools.description: Read an existing bounded redacted improvement artifact without regenerating or queueing work.

tools.name: get_usage_summary
tools.title: Get aggregate usage summary
tools.description: Read bounded aggregate visits, visitors, conversions, and standard breakdowns for one authorized project.

tools.name: get_route_metrics
tools.title: Get aggregate route metrics
tools.description: Read bounded aggregate traffic, entry, exit, bounce, and linked-incident counts by route.

tools.name: get_journey_patterns
tools.title: Get aggregate journey patterns
tools.description: Read bounded aggregate route transitions without individual journey samples or sample identifiers.

tools.name: get_device_breakdown
tools.title: Get aggregate device breakdown
tools.description: Read bounded aggregate device, browser, operating-system, and language metrics.

tools.name: get_referrer_metrics
tools.title: Get aggregate acquisition metrics
tools.description: Read bounded aggregate referrer and standard UTM-source, medium, and campaign metrics.

tools.name: get_action_metrics
tools.title: Get aggregate action metrics
tools.description: Read bounded aggregate action, conversion, and marker counts for one authorized project.

tools.name: list_funnel_metrics
tools.title: List aggregate funnel metrics
tools.description: List bounded aggregate funnel entry, completion, dropoff, and conversion metrics.

tools.name: get_funnel_analysis
tools.title: Get aggregate funnel analysis
tools.description: Read bounded aggregate step and conversion metrics for one named funnel.

tools.name: get_incident_impact
tools.title: Get aggregate incident impact
tools.description: Read bounded aggregate audience, route, funnel, and transition impact for one incident without samples or bundle generation.

tools.name: list_health_checks
tools.title: List endpoint health checks
tools.description: List saved endpoint-health checks with sanitized display URLs for one authorized project.

tools.name: get_health_check
tools.title: Get an endpoint health check
tools.description: Read one endpoint-health definition with a sanitized HTTP(S) display URL and no internal scheduling state.

tools.name: list_health_check_results
tools.title: List endpoint health results
tools.description: List bounded recent outcomes for one authorized endpoint-health check.

tools.name: list_health_check_daily_rollups
tools.title: List daily endpoint health summaries
tools.description: List bounded daily uptime and failure summaries for one authorized endpoint-health check.
